visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Zillow Showcase. Photos plus 3D / floor plan / map tabs, one monthly payment with P&I tax HOA, nearby schools, tax history, lot size. We add place climb, assessor lot lines, published CC&Rs, a live broker, and one payment formula (computeMonthlyPiti).
note: PAGE_INVENTORY listing (house URL) 12 sections. Tour / Call / Text is the ask WHILE THE HOME IS ON THE MARKET, Pending included (a pending home takes backup offers and is a live lead source). SITE-21: when isPublicOffMarketStatus(status) is true — Closed, Expired, Canceled, Withdrawn — the page publishes the sold facts, the active homes in this city and a saved search instead: no payment, no market-ask instrument, no three-act close, and no tel: or sms: anywhere inside <main> (the brokerage line stays in V3Footer, outside it). Face Est. $/mo is off the page so Payment is the one number. Cookies cannot cover the ask. No leftover HUD, CMA, rental, or doors on this route.

dataChanges.unchanged: Every listing figure traces to getListingDetail, photos, videos, history, open houses, brokers, reviews, related homes, plat documents, taxlots. JSON-LD RealEstateListing + BreadcrumbList still emit from MetadataBlock. Payment is computeMonthlyPiti only.
dataChanges.similarHomes: A capped strip of V3ListingRow from the same relatedHomes ranking, same parent. One view-more href.
dataChanges.exploreSections: Parks and trails nearby via LifestyleNearSection thumbs. Golf, events, and city guides are omitted on this house page.

openDefects._: Closed 2026-08-27. Insurance is now an editable input seeded at $1,000 per $300K per year with the assumption stated in the UI; the comparison sentence says 'median list price'; the grain item resolved below.
items: RESOLVED AS CLAIM-WRONG 2026-08-27: NeighborhoodMarketContext publishes the FINEST grain whose rows publish (neighborhood first, city fallback via leftoverListingGrains) and the heading names that grain. Subdivision-grain stats cannot ship honestly: subdivision monthly series are too sparse to chart and neighborhood sold attribution is a known text-join undercount. The page is truthful about its grain; the contract's flat subdivision-grain promise was the wrong side.

OPEN, NEEDS MATT (SITE-33, 2026-09-09). On an OUT-OF-AREA listing the page now says "We don't work in Medford" and offers a broker introduction, while the sidebar card and the mobile bar still offer Tour / Call / Text, and the Payment section still computes a full monthly breakdown for that home. The separate evaluator called the first of these critical: two contradictory asks in one viewport. It was NOT changed in this pass. Matt's 2026-09-08 ruling was explicit and covered four things — the honesty block, noindex with follow preserved, the page still serving, and /oregon/[city] staying indexed — and did not rule on the ask. SITE-21 is the precedent for the fix (it already strips tel:, sms: and the payment from a home the brokerage cannot transact), but out-of-area is not off-market: Ryan Realty holds an Oregon licence and these are live leads, so suppressing the tour CTA on ~4,190 listings is a revenue decision, not a taste one. THE ASK FOR MATT: on an out-of-area listing, does the page keep Tour / Call / Text and the payment, or does it drop to the referral ask alone?

tasteReview.evaluator: separate claude-sonnet-5 evaluator agent, SITE-45 listing-opening pass, session 019RdEm6 — the table instrument (first viewport at 1440x900 and 375x812, scripts/take-route-shots.mjs, scale 1, palette-quantized) on the lane's own dev server (localhost:3198) for the Bend route at the top of the page and at its close section, the Medford route at its out-of-area notice, plus two hover records per viewport (the pointer on the filmstrip, the pointer on the price-cut mark) read only for the Interaction criterion; three independent scorings of one capture run, the median; no page code read, no live page opened. The builder ran on Opus and did not grade its own page. The prior mark is this file's committed receipt (77: 77·78·76, 2026-09-09, the SITE-33 out-of-area pass on the mosaic build).

shotSpec.capture: scripts/take-route-shots.mjs default first viewport for the instrument pair; `close` for the close section; `outofarea=#out-of-area` on the Medford route; `strip=#listing-hero-visual .listing-strip@#listing-hero-visual!hover` and `drop=.listing-drop!hover` for the hover records

tasteReview.beats: Redfin — this page's #close section turns a bare price-history table into a plain-English narrative ('46% of homes that sold had dropped price') backed by a dot-matrix chart and a day-count comparison; Redfin shows the same underlying facts as an unglossed table with no interpretation.
tells: Raw slugs, internal labels or methodology jargon in anything a visitor reads — the breadcrumb reads 'Bend / Easton / EASTON COMMERCIAL / 60936 SE Apollo Place' on a single-family home, both desktop.png and mobile375.png.
tasteReview.dullest: The #out-of-area prose block — two paragraphs of unencoded text with a single link is the only section on the route that isn't carrying a figure, chart, or interactive element, so it's the one a reader's eye slides past.
tasteReview.verdict: This build fixed real things: the broker card and reviews now sit inside the fold, the price cut is a hover-reveal instead of static text, and the KPI pills finally carry a plain-English sentence. But the same three named defects from the prior mark survive untouched — the Medford CTA contradicting 'we don't work here,' a mortgage calculator computing a confident dollar figure on a lot it just admitted no local knowledge of, and a raw plat alias leaking into the breadcrumb — and those are exactly the kind of thing a demanding director would call unacceptable on a second pass. Ship the interaction and layout wins; treat the Medford contradiction as a blocker, not a backlog item.

defects.finding: Breadcrumb shows the raw plat/subdivision alias 'EASTON COMMERCIAL' in all caps ahead of the address on a residential listing — reads as an internal slug, not a place a buyer would recognize.
defects.fix: Suppress or humanize the subdivision alias before render; drop 'COMMERCIAL' segments on residential listings.

defects.finding: The broker card still offers Tour / Call / Text for the Medford lot directly beside copy stating 'We don't work in Medford' — the CTA contradicts the disclaimer in the same viewport.
defects.fix: On out-of-area listings, replace Tour/Call/Text with the 'introduce me to a Medford broker' action; do not show the generic tour CTA.

defects.finding: The mortgage calculator still renders a precise $2,315/month, line-item breakdown for the Medford lot in the same block that admits Ryan Realty has no local knowledge of Medford — a specific number implies authority the copy just disclaimed.
defects.fix: Hide or generic-ize the calculator on out-of-area listings, or caveat it explicitly as a statewide-rate estimate carrying no local knowledge.

defects.finding: At 375, the breadcrumb wraps into an orphaned second line ('/ 60936 SE Apollo Place') separated from 'Bend / Easton / EASTON COMMERCIAL' above it.
defects.fix: Truncate to the last one or two segments at 375, or collapse to a back-chevron, instead of wrapping the full trail.

defects.finding: The explanation is two paragraphs of prose plus one text link and nothing else visual — the one section on the route with no figure, chart, or map, even though it stays under the two-paragraph banned-tell line.
defects.fix: Replace one paragraph with a simple service-area map or a labeled distance stat ('Medford is X miles outside our 14-community coverage').

defects.finding: The Facts block (lot size / year built / HOA) is plain static text with no hover, tap, or expand — the one clearly non-interactive data block on the route.
defects.fix: Add a lightweight interaction, e.g. tap-to-expand each fact with its source, or link acreage to a map overlay.

defects.finding: SITE-99 product hold, not a re-score. Desktop CSS had hidden listing-face__actions at 64rem because the sidebar already had Tour / Call / Text, which also hid Save and Share. Those two stay on the live control (listing-face__keep) on Active, Pending, and off-market. Search tiles stay no-heart.
defects.fix: Keep the keep-group painted. Do not hide Save/Share with the ask row. Do not add hearts to search tiles.
